chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muhammad, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from Dāwūd ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Abū ʿUbaydah, who said:
I heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, and he saw the people in Makkah and what they were doing. He said: “Deeds like the deeds of the Jāhiliyyah.”
Indeed, by Allah, they were not commanded with this; and they were not commanded except that they should remove their untidiness and fulfill their vows.
Then they should pass by us and inform us of their wilayah, and present to us their support.

key_terms.الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ: the pre-Islamic age of ignorance; here, a comparison for misguided religious practice
key_terms.بِنَا: by us; referring to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.بِوَلَايَتِهِمْ: with their wilayah; their allegiance and loyal devotion to the rightful authority
key_terms.تَفَثَهُمْ: their ritual untidiness or the remaining state removed after completing hajj rites
key_terms.نُذُورَهُمْ: their vows made obligatory upon themselves and to be fulfilled

ai.seo_question: After completing the rites of hajj, what were people expected to do according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith criticizes outward ritual action at Makkah when detached from the divinely mandated connection to the Imam عليه السلام. It links the completion of hajj rites with coming to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, declaring one’s wilayah, and offering support. It also alludes to the Qur'anic command to complete pilgrimage obligations and fulfill vows.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Dawood Bin Al Na’man, from Abu Ubeyda who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> saw the people at Makkah and what they were doing. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Their deeds are like the deeds of the Pre-Islamic period.
But, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, they have not been Commanded with this, and they have not been Commanded with except that they should complete their Hajj, and let them fulfil their vows.
Then they should pass by us<sup>asws</sup> and they should inform us<sup>asws</sup> of their Wilayah and present their help to us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Asbat from Dawud ibn al-Ni‘man from abu ‘Ubayda who has said the following.
“I heard abu Ja‘far say, (a.s.) when he saw people in Makka and what they were doing, “Activities like those in the days of ignorance.
By Allah, they are not commanded to do as suCh
What they are commanded to do is to complete their Hajj, relieve themselves of the obligations of vows and visit us to inform us of their support and express their help before us.”
